subject.title: refactor(protocol): pre-publish cheat-window cleanup and vintage tracking

question: Should the project accept the stated beta/pre-publication compatibility window for the removed exports and reshaped `question.*` and session-catalog contracts after the health regression is fixed?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes a large shared protocol surface and asserts that affected callers are unshipped; that release-contract boundary cannot be established solely from the supplied diff.

options.title: Accept the audited compatibility window
options.body: Confirm that the affected protocol families and exports are not supported shipped contracts, then land after the health-schema repair and proof.

options.title: Preserve transitional protocol compatibility
options.body: Retain or add a narrowly documented migration path for any beta or external consumer that maintainers decide remains supported.

recommendation.title: Accept the audited compatibility window
recommendation.body: Confirm that the affected protocol families and exports are not supported shipped contracts, then land after the health-schema repair and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned contributor and authored the stated shipped-surface audit and protocol changes.
